scope: Semantic classification of the nineteen Vedic-domain krt identifiers exposed by pinned Vidyut 0.4.0 plus kvasu, whose general Vedic domain is supplied by Ashtadhyayi 3.2.107 despite the engine metadata. Alternative suffixes and accent variants do not become separate word-meanings merely because their forms differ.

operations.semantic_relation: a participant characterized by the base action in the Vedic perfect
operations.condition: Vedic domain; kAnac optionally replaces lit

operations.semantic_relation: an active participant characterized by the base action in the Vedic perfect
operations.condition: Vedic domain generally; later rules separately license limited forms in bhasha

operations.semantic_relation: the purpose of performing the base action
the base action as the purpose complement of sak, to be capable
operations.condition: Vedic domain; sak is the accompanying verb

operations.semantic_relation: the base action as the purpose complement of isvara, to be capable
operations.condition: Vedic domain; isvara is the accompanying word

operations.semantic_relation: the base action marks the event boundary for another action
operations.condition: Vedic domain; bhavalaksana; limited to stha, i, kr, vad, car, hu, tam, and jan

operations.semantic_relation: the base action marks the event boundary for another action
operations.condition: Vedic domain; bhavalaksana; limited to srp and trd
